note: Showroom feed — every image features real products SDLR installs, and each caption names the selections so followers can DM to get the look. Shot mix: desert-modern fire, modern entertainment yard, driveway curb appeal, coastal pergola lounge, aerial putting green. Post natively in the Instagram app.

posts.alt: Rancho Bernardo desert-modern sunken fire lounge with board-formed concrete seat walls, a linear fire feature and agave against chaparral hills at dusk
posts.hook: Inland heat, engineered into an evening you'll want to sit through.
posts.caption:
Inland evenings have a trick the coast doesn't: the hills go quiet and the temperature finally turns friendly. Build the fire to face them and you'll never sit anywhere else.

Seat walls poured in board-formed concrete, a long clean run of flame, planting that thrives on being left alone.

The selections:
• Warming Trends linear burner
• board-formed concrete seat walls
• Techo-Bloc Blu 60 pavers
• agave & aloe
• FX Luminaire lighting

Want a place to end the day like this? DM “DESIGN”.

posts.alt: Modern San Diego backyard with a fire pit, built-in seating and outdoor kitchen in golden-hour light
posts.hook: One space. Cook, gather, and stay a while.
posts.caption:
The best backyards do more than one job at once — without feeling crowded.

Kitchen, fire, and seating share a single deck here, zoned so the cook, the crowd, and the quiet corner all coexist. Flow first; everything else follows.

The selections:
• linear fire pit
• built-in bench seating
• stainless grill island
• Belgard pavers
• café string lights

Want a yard that does it all? DM “DESIGN”.

posts.alt: Wide concrete driveway with a stone-facade home and drought-tolerant landscaping in San Diego
posts.hook: Curb appeal is the cheapest square footage you own.
posts.caption:
You spend more time looking at your front yard than almost any room in the house. It should earn that attention.

Wide-format concrete with a paver band, stone veneer to tie into the façade, and structured drought-tolerant planting that looks sharp in every season.

The selections:
• wide-format concrete with paver banding
• stone-veneer accents
• agave & olive
• decomposed-granite borders
• FX Luminaire path lighting

Want the front to match the back? DM “DESIGN”.

posts.alt: Coastal San Diego backyard with a pergola, teak lounge and ocean view at golden hour
posts.hook: Shade where you want it, sun where you don't.
posts.caption:
A pergola isn't decoration — it's how you make a west-facing yard usable at 4pm in August.

Sited to throw shade over the lounge while leaving the view wide open, built in materials that weather beautifully by the coast.

The selections:
• cedar & steel pergola
• teak lounge seating
• travertine paving
• glass wind wall
• olive & ornamental grasses

Want shade without losing the view? DM “DESIGN”.
